items.title: Widerspruch gegen Anerkennungsbescheid einlegen
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, Widerspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter posted/dated 20.11.2026 (Friday). Delivery fiction per § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X (stated in letter): deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting = 24.11.2026 (Tuesday). For social-law bodies the delivery day itself is not shifted even if it fell on a weekend/holiday (here it is a normal Tuesday anyway). One-month Widerspruch period per § 84 SGG starts the day after delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends on the day with the same number in the following month (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 24.12.2026. 24 December is a regular working day in Germany (not a public holiday), and it is a Thursday, so no weekend/holiday shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X is needed. Final day: 24.12.2026.
